summary: The authors’ [Three Bears archive](https://churchilllab.jax.org/threebears/) contains NZO diet-effect tables for six tissues, all outside hypothalamus. GEO provides hypothalamus expression and annotation, and the conference abstract reports a tissue response without gene-level estimates. The proposal records `partial` availability and `not_comparable`; author concordance remains unassessed. All 63 retained source files passed SHA-256 verification.
openIssues: A numerical comparison requires author gene-level HFHS-versus-control results for NZO hypothalamus, with the cohort, effect direction and sex adjustment documented.
The twelve registered libraries match GEO by tissue, strain, sex and diet. Their individual mouse and cage assignments remain unresolved.
